references.text: Moses did everything just as the Lord had commanded him—a recurring theme that shows Moses’ faithful obedience to God’s commands.
Moses saw all the work, and they had done it just as the Lord had commanded—the same pattern of obedience to the Lord’s command.
Joshua was filled with the spirit of wisdom because Moses had laid his hands on him—showing Moses’ faithful execution of God’s commands.
Moses did just as the Lord had commanded him—the same wording used earlier in the chapter, showing Moses’ consistent obedience.
Moses was faithful in all God’s house—the New Testament confirms Moses’ faithfulness in carrying out everything God commanded him.
